description: Source code for SafetyService class providing travel safety tips and emergency contacts with in-memory data and future API integration.

classes.name: SafetyService
classes.description: Class offering methods to retrieve safety tips, emergency contacts, and region data for travel safety application.

methods.name: listRegions
methods.description: Returns a list of available regions with basic labels.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns detailed data for a specific region, including tips and emergency contacts.

methods.name: searchTips
methods.description: Searches tips across all regions based on query, category, and severity filters.

methods.name: listTipsByRegion
methods.description: Returns tips for a specific region with optional filters.

methods.name: getEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Provides emergency contact info and placeholder embassy info for a region.

methods.name: suggestCountryPresets
methods.description: Provides a sorted list of country presets for UI selection.

methods.name: getCategoryList
methods.description: Returns list of categories used for filtering tips.
